about_the_game:
Has someone ever told you to touch grass, but you just couldn’t bring yourself to do it? Well, boy, do I have good news for you: In Grass Toucher, you can do it as much and as long as you want.

Aside from the breathtaking experience of touching grass, Grass Toucher features:

  • Fun and satisfying clicker gameplay

  • Charming 2D graphics

  • Minimalist and clean interface

  • 12 unique buildings to buy

  • 210 special upgrades to unlock

  • 47 Steam achievements

  • Detailed stats menu to view your progress

  • Golden Grass power-up for temporary boosts

  • Peaceful backgrounds to calm your soul

  • Bright sun to meet your virtual vitamin D needs

  • Realistic grass-touching sound effects

  • Relaxing music by Kevin MacLeod

  • Auto and manual save systems

  • Support for 31 languages

  • Fully playable using only a mouse

  • Optional setting to turn your cursor into a hand

  • Idle and active gameplay styles

  • Suitable for both short and long play sessions

  • 16:9 resolution and fullscreen support

  • Low system requirements

  • No internet required

  • No microtransactions

Now it's time to touch some grass. Show the world how many times you've done it, and become a true Grass Toucher. And don’t forget to touch "Add to your wishlist" button. It's the second best thing you can touch.

short_description: Do you have what it takes? Are you brave enough to touch the mysterious green organism known as "grass"? Grass Toucher is a clicker game where you touch grass, buy buildings, and unlock special upgrades. Experience the thrill of touching grass without ever stepping outside.
